name: Bedburg (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red in the proportions 1:4:1, charged towards the hoist with the city arms of Bedburg (a white lion with a crenellated bar and a red shield).
history: The hoisted flag is red/white/red in the ratio 1:4:1 with the city shield in the middle stripe slightly towards the hoist; the banner has the shield slightly above the centre.

features.role: Bedburg arms — lion, crenellated bar and shield
